evidence.quote: for citizens of all other countries 2 750 EUR / semester

notes: The programme's own pages state 7 semesters (3.5 years), while the Studyfinder page also lists 7 semesters. Tuition of 2 750 EUR/semester is the fee stated for "citizens of all other countries" (i.e. non-EU/EEA), so it is the applicable tuition for a Moroccan applicant. The application deadline on the programme page is given as "Deadline for Application: 31th May" without a year and without a statement that it is for non-EU/international applicants, so no intake fact was extracted. Presented entry requirements (Minimum level of language proficiency B2, CEFR B2 language exam certificate) are listed under "Requirements" on the Studyfinder page but only a soft statement was found on the programme pages, so they were not extracted as a rule.

note.fr: Examen d'entrée : test de mathématiques en ligne (0-20 points) ; l'échec au test (moins de 50%) entraîne le rejet de la candidature.
note.en: Entrance exam: online Mathematics test (0-20 points); not attending or scoring below 50% means the application must be rejected.

evidence.quote: You must complete a Mathematics test as a part of the admission process.
Your application must be rejected if you are not attending the test or the result is below 50%.

note.fr: Un entretien oral en ligne (Skype) est organisé après le test de mathématiques ; il fait partie de la procédure d'admission.
note.en: An online oral (Skype) entrance examination is organized after the mathematics test; it is part of the admission process.

note.fr: Critère d'éligibilité : score total d'au moins 60 points (sans points supplémentaires) selon le système d'évaluation sur 100 points.
note.en: Eligibility criterion: a total score of at least 60 (without extra points) in the 100-point evaluation system.

evidence.quote: Minimum eligibility criteria for admissions the total score, of at least 60, without extra points.
